scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @insta/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @insta/api" "npm run dev -w @insta/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @insta/api && npm run build -w @insta/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @insta/api && npm run typecheck -w @insta/web
